+"""Execute methods with label-free inputs and preserve every attempt."""
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import importlib.metadata
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import platform
+import time
+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from backend.evaluation.baselines import git_baseline, git_script_baseline, llm_baseline, agentic_system
+from backend.services.evidence_verifier import audit, prediction_hash
+from backend.services.git_evidence import git
+from evaluation.dataset import TASKS, TARGETS, load_dataset, write_json
+from evaluation.metrics import intent_metrics, scope_metrics, recovery_metrics, evidence_metrics
+
+METHODS = {"git": "Git baseline", "git_script": "Git log/blame script", "llm": "Single-prompt LLM", "aicar": "Proposed AICAR"}
+
+
+def now():
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def digest(value):
+    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def validate_prediction(task, result, pack):
+    if not isinstance(result, dict):
+        raise ValueError("Prediction must be a JSON object")
+    if not isinstance(result.get("claims"), list) or not all(isinstance(c, dict) and isinstance(c.get("text"), str) for c in result["claims"]):
+        raise ValueError("Prediction must include a list of textual claims")
+    for claim in result["claims"]:
+        if any(claim.get(k) is not None and not isinstance(claim[k], str) for k in ("commit", "file", "hunk", "quote", "kind")):
+            raise ValueError("Claim references must be strings or null")
+    if task == "intent":
+        if not isinstance(result.get("intent"), str) or not result["intent"].strip():
+            raise ValueError("Intent prediction must be nonempty text")
+    elif task == "scope":
+        if not isinstance(result.get("hunks"), dict) or set(result["hunks"]) != {h["id"] for h in pack["hunks"]}:
+            raise ValueError("Scope prediction must classify every exact hunk ID")
+        if any(v not in {"in-scope", "out-of-scope", "unclear"} for v in result["hunks"].values()):
+            raise ValueError("Invalid scope class")
+        if result.get("verdict") not in {"keep", "split", "justify"}:
+            raise ValueError("Invalid scope verdict")
+    else:
+        score = result.get("score")
+        if score is not None and (type(score) not in {int, float} or not math.isfinite(score) or not 0 <= score <= 1):
+            raise ValueError("Recovery score must be null or a finite number in [0,1]")
+
+
+def execute(dataset, output, *, smoke=False, live=False, tasks=TASKS):
+    output = Path(output)
+    started = now()
+    clock = time.perf_counter()
+    # No predictions, output replacement, or external calls before dataset validation.
+    data = load_dataset(dataset, allow_unlabelled=smoke, tasks=tasks)
+    preparation_seconds = time.perf_counter() - clock
+    if live and (not os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY") or not os.getenv("GEMINI_MODEL")):
+        raise ValueError("Live execution requires GEMINI_API_KEY and an explicit GEMINI_MODEL; no fallback permitted")
+    run_id = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S") + "_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
+    run_path = output / "raw" / run_id
+    raw = []
+    adjudication_templates = []
+    for task in tasks:
+        for case in data["cases"][task]:
+            pack = data["packs"][case["case_id"]]
+            pack_digest = digest(pack)
+            write_json(run_path / "evidence" / f"{case['case_id']}.json", pack)
+            for method in METHODS:
+                entry = {"case_id": case["case_id"], "task": task, "method": method,
+                    "repository": case["repository"], "commit": case["revision"],
+                    "file": case.get("file"), "region": case.get("region"),
+                    "hunks": [h["id"] for h in pack["hunks"]], "evidence_sha256": pack_digest,
+                    "repositories": 1, "files": pack["file_count"], "commits": pack["commit_count"],
+                    "code_regions": 1 if task == "intent" else len(pack["hunks"]),
+                    "start_time": None, "end_time": None, "total_seconds": None,
+                    "mode": "live" if live and method in {"llm", "aicar"} else "offline"}
+                if method == "llm" and not live:
+                    entry.update(status="skipped", reason="Live LLM execution not enabled")
+                    raw.append(entry)
+                    continue
+                entry["start_time"] = now()
+                tick = time.perf_counter()
+                try:
+                    inputs = copy.deepcopy(pack)
+                    if method == "aicar":
+                        prediction = agentic_system.predict(task, inputs, live=live)
+                    else:
+                        prediction = {"git": git_baseline, "git_script": git_script_baseline, "llm": llm_baseline}[method].predict(task, inputs)
+                    entry["prediction"] = prediction
+                    validate_prediction(task, prediction, pack)
+                    entry.update(status="ok", prediction=prediction, prediction_sha256=prediction_hash(prediction))
+                except Exception as error:
+                    # Do not persist provider exception strings, which can contain credentials/URLs.
+                    entry.update(status="error", reason=type(error).__name__ + ": method failed; no prediction scored")
+                entry["total_seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - tick
+                entry["end_time"] = now()
+                if entry["status"] == "ok":
+                    entry["evidence_audit"] = audit(entry["prediction"], pack)
+                    adjudication_templates.append({"case_id": case["case_id"], "method": method,
+                        "prediction_sha256": entry["prediction_sha256"], "intent_correct": None,
+                        "annotator": None, "rationale": None,
+                        "claims": [{"text": c["claim"]["text"], "supported": None, "rationale": None}
+                                   for c in entry["evidence_audit"]["claims"]]})
+                raw.append(entry)
+    summaries = summarize(data, raw, smoke, tasks)
+    packages = {}
+    for package in ("GitPython", "google-genai", "pytest", "matplotlib"):
+        try:
+            packages[package] = importlib.metadata.version(package)
+        except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
+            packages[package] = None
+    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+    code_files = sorted([*root.glob("evaluation/*.py"), *root.glob("evaluation/runners/*.py"), *root.glob("backend/**/*.py")])
+    provenance = {"python": platform.python_version(), "platform": platform.platform(), "packages": packages,
+        "git_version": git(root, "--version").strip(), "code_revision": git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").strip(),
+        "code_sha256": {str(p.relative_to(root)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in code_files},
+        "dataset_sha256": {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(Path(dataset).glob("*.json"))},
+        "model": os.getenv("GEMINI_MODEL") if live else None, "temperature": 0 if live else None,
+        "evidence_as_of": data["manifest"]["as_of"]}
+    result = {"schema_version": 1, "run_id": run_id, "status": "unscored_smoke" if smoke else "scored",
+        "start_time": started, "end_time": now(), "total_seconds": time.perf_counter() - clock,
+        "preparation_seconds": preparation_seconds, "timing_scope": "validation/extraction plus method execution; shared extraction is measured separately, report/plot generation excluded",
+        "dataset": data["counts"], "targets_not_observed": TARGETS,
+        "attempts": len(raw), "executed": sum(r["status"] != "skipped" for r in raw),
+        "successful": sum(r["status"] == "ok" for r in raw), "errors": sum(r["status"] == "error" for r in raw),
+        "skipped": sum(r["status"] == "skipped" for r in raw), "scored_cases": 0 if smoke else sum(len(data["cases"][t]) for t in tasks),
+        "methods": summaries, "provenance": provenance}
+    write_json(run_path / "predictions.json", raw)
+    write_json(run_path / "manifest.json", result)
+    write_json(run_path / "review_template.json", adjudication_templates)
+    write_json(output / "processed" / f"{run_id}.json", summaries)
+    return result, raw
+
+
+def summarize(data, raw, smoke, tasks):
+    summaries = {}
+    for method, name in METHODS.items():
+        rows = [r for r in raw if r["method"] == method]
+        pairs = {t: [] for t in TASKS}
+        task_status = {}
+        for task in tasks:
+            selected = [r for r in rows if r["task"] == task]
+            complete = bool(selected) and all(r["status"] == "ok" for r in selected)
+            task_status[task] = "unscored smoke" if smoke else ("complete" if complete else "unavailable: method skipped or failed")
+            if not smoke and complete:
+                mapping = {c["case_id"]: c for c in data["cases"][task]}
+                pairs[task] = [(mapping[r["case_id"]], r["prediction"]) for r in selected]
+                for row in selected:
+                    pair = [(mapping[row["case_id"]], row["prediction"])]
+                    row["metrics"] = intent_metrics(pair) if task == "intent" else scope_metrics(pair) if task == "scope" else None
+        audits = [r["evidence_audit"] for r in rows if r["task"] == "intent" and r["status"] == "ok"] if pairs["intent"] else []
+        summaries[method] = {"name": name, "task_status": task_status,
+            "intent": intent_metrics(pairs["intent"]), "scope": scope_metrics(pairs["scope"]),
+            "recovery": recovery_metrics(pairs["recovery"]), "evidence": evidence_metrics(audits),
+            "analysis_seconds": (sum(r["total_seconds"] for r in rows if r["total_seconds"] is not None)
+                                 if any(r["total_seconds"] is not None for r in rows) else None),
+            "executed": sum(r["status"] != "skipped" for r in rows),
+            "mode": next((r["mode"] for r in rows), None)}
+    return summaries

+"""Add a real local checkout to the dataset; never create semantic labels."""
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+from backend.services.git_evidence import git, snapshot
+from evaluation.dataset import TASKS, read_json, write_json
+
+
+def prepare(repository, directory, repo_id, limit=4):
+    directory = Path(directory).resolve()
+    repository = Path(repository).resolve()
+    revision = git(repository, "rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()
+    manifest_path = directory / "repositories.json"
+    manifest = read_json(manifest_path) if manifest_path.exists() else {
+        "schema_version": 1, "as_of": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "repositories": []}
+    if any(r["id"] == repo_id or (directory / r["path"]).resolve() == repository for r in manifest["repositories"]):
+        raise ValueError("Repository already registered; existing annotations are never overwritten")
+    try:
+        source = git(repository, "remote", "get-url", "origin").strip()
+    except ValueError:
+        source = str(repository)
+    manifest["repositories"].append({"id": repo_id, "source": source,
+        "path": Path(os.path.relpath(repository, directory)).as_posix(), "revision": revision})
+    cases = {t: read_json(directory / f"{t}_cases.json") if (directory / f"{t}_cases.json").exists() else [] for t in TASKS}
+    pending = {"status": "pending", "annotator": None, "rationale": None}
+    # Include only commits changing source code. Documentation commits are not invented code cases.
+    selected = 0
+    for sha in git(repository, "rev-list", revision).splitlines():
+        changed = git(repository, "diff-tree", "--root", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", "--first-parent", sha).splitlines()
+        files = set(git(repository, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", sha).splitlines())
+        source_files = [f for f in changed if f in files and Path(f).name != "__init__.py" and Path(f).suffix in {".py", ".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".java", ".go", ".rs", ".c", ".cpp"}]
+        if not source_files:
+            continue
+        selected += 1
+        file = sorted(source_files)[0]
+        lines = len(git(repository, "show", f"{sha}:{file}").splitlines())
+        if not lines:
+            continue
+        common = {"repository": repo_id, "revision": sha, "annotation": pending.copy()}
+        cid = f"{repo_id}_intent_{sha[:12]}"
+        case = {**common, "case_id": cid, "file": file, "region": [1, min(lines, 30)],
+                "gold_intent": None, "accepted_intents": [], "introducing_commit": None, "supporting_commits": []}
+        cases["intent"].append(case)
+        pack = snapshot(repository, sha, file=file, region=case["region"], as_of=manifest["as_of"])
+        write_json(directory / "evidence" / f"{cid}.json", pack)
+        cid = f"{repo_id}_scope_{sha[:12]}"
+        if pack["hunks"]:
+            cases["scope"].append({**common, "case_id": cid, "task": None,
+                "task_source": {"reference": None, "text": None}, "diff": pack["diff"],
+                "gold_hunks": {h["id"]: None for h in pack["hunks"]}, "gold_verdict": None})
+            write_json(directory / "evidence" / f"{cid}.json", pack)
+        if selected >= limit:
+            break
+    cid = f"{repo_id}_recovery"
+    cases["recovery"].append({"case_id": cid, "repository": repo_id, "revision": revision,
+        "unfinished": None, "gold_rank": None, "gold_recoverability": None, "annotation": pending.copy()})
+    write_json(directory / "evidence" / f"{cid}.json", snapshot(repository, revision, as_of=manifest["as_of"]))
+    for task in TASKS:
+        write_json(directory / f"{task}_cases.json", cases[task])
+    write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
+    return {t: len(cases[t]) for t in TASKS}
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--repository", type=Path, default=ROOT)
+    parser.add_argument("--dataset", type=Path, default=ROOT / "evaluation/datasets")
+    parser.add_argument("--id", default="aicar")
+    parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=4)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.limit < 1:
+        parser.error("--limit must be positive")
+    try:
+        print(prepare(args.repository, args.dataset, args.id, args.limit))
+    except (ValueError, OSError) as error:
+        parser.exit(2, str(error) + "\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Inspection before implementation
+
+Inspected the original repository at `07b121617c2a064e5e16c43db73a4ee852de864c`.
+The only pre-existing working-tree change was `frontend/package-lock.json`.
+
+1. **Architecture:** React/TypeScript/Vite dashboard, history and comparison pages;
+   Axios through the Vite API proxy; FastAPI endpoints in `backend/main.py`;
+   LangGraph workflow in `backend/graph/workflow.py`; SQLite/SQLAlchemy storage in
+   `backend/database.py` and `backend/models/analysis.py`.
+2. **Existing functionality:** repository cloning and Git extraction, recent
+   commit/file histories, TODO scanning, intent/scope/recovery analysis, narrative
+   report/recommendation agents, health heuristics, persisted analysis history,
+   repository comparison and commit/file graph visualization.
+3. **Actually implemented:** GitPython extraction capped at ten recent commits,
+   five file diffs and truncated patches; evidence-map construction but no evidence
+   verification; scope by filenames rather than hunks; recovery and comparison
+   heuristics, not a validated ranking model. Repository-list endpoint returns
+   mock entries. README's OpenAI description does not match the Gemini code.
+4. **Missing research infrastructure:** pinned real dataset, human labels,
+   provenance, valid evidence support checks, hunk classification, recovery nDCG,
+   baseline parity, raw timing, reproducibility, uncertainty/missing-data handling.
+   Legacy examples contain placeholder SHAs; existing saved results have no
+   corresponding traceable experiment outputs and must not be treated as measured.
+5. **Tests:** manual Markdown checklists and saved PASS examples, no executable
+   automated tests. Frontend provides build/lint scripts. README refers to a
+   missing backend requirements file and incorrect evaluation entry point.
+6. **LLM/fallback:** Gemini SDK, model hardcoded in each agent, clients initialized
+   at import time. `USE_GEMINI_ANALYSIS` defaults false, intent copies the commit
+   message, scope reports insufficient evidence, recovery emits generic medium
+   potential. `.env.example` originally names only `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
+7. **Implementation files:** extend `backend/services/repository_analyzer.py`;
+   add `git_evidence.py`, `llm.py`, `evidence_verifier.py`; extend existing agents
+   with lazy provider access and structured task evaluation; replace legacy
+   backend evaluation entry points/metrics/baselines with a common audited runner;
+   add `evaluation/dataset.py`, `prepare_dataset.py`, `pipeline.py`, `metrics.py`,
+   `reporting.py`, `figures.py`, task runners, datasets, annotation guide and tests.

+# AICAR reproducible evaluation
+
+## Experimental setup
+
+Run `20260922T171748_8f614331`: **unscored_smoke**. Pinned Git objects; shared evidence per case. Python 3.13.9. Model: disabled. All measurements below come from this run.
+
+## Dataset size
+
+{
+  "intent": 3,
+  "scope": 3,
+  "recovery": 1,
+  "repositories": 1,
+  "commits": 4,
+  "labelled": 0,
+  "pending": 7
+}
+
+## Dataset composition
+
+Source paths, origins and immutable revisions: evaluation/datasets/repositories.json. Code-case candidates are commits changing source; recovery eligibility is unconfirmed until annotated. Targets (25 repositories, 40 intent, 30 scope, 20 recovery, approximately 1,800 commits) are not achieved dataset counts.
+
+## Ground-truth methodology
+
+Human annotation is mandatory; see evaluation/ANNOTATION_GUIDE.md. No labels are copied from the paper, legacy examples, commit messages, or model predictions. Intent uses preregistered normalized exact accepted answers; this is a strict textual metric, not a semantic correctness claim. Human semantic review is exported separately and not automatically scored.
+
+## Baselines
+
+Git: commit message extraction; scope abstention; no recovery rank. Git log/blame script: single-origin line-blame message plus history summary; ambiguous provenance abstains. Single-prompt Gemini: one common evidence pack per task, no specialized agent or verifier. Offline runs skip Gemini. No manual human analysis time is claimed.
+
+## AICAR architecture
+
+Existing repository analyzer's pinned-snapshot path, existing intent/scope/recovery agents with structured evaluation outputs, and evidence verifier. Dashboard's LangGraph/report route is not timed. Offline AICAR retains intent message fallback and abstains on semantic scope/recovery. Live outputs use specialized task instructions. This is a task-agent evaluation, not a measured end-to-end dashboard benchmark.
+
+## Intent results
+
+Git baseline: {'accuracy': None, 'cases': 0, 'correct': 0, 'incorrect': 0, 'introducing_commit_accuracy': None}
+Git log/blame script: {'accuracy': None, 'cases': 0, 'correct': 0, 'incorrect': 0, 'introducing_commit_accuracy': None}

+## Evidence-support results
+
+Git baseline: {'supported': 0, 'total_verifiable': 0, 'rate': None}
+Git log/blame script: {'supported': 0, 'total_verifiable': 0, 'rate': None}
+Single-prompt LLM: {'supported': 0, 'total_verifiable': 0, 'rate': None}
+Proposed AICAR: {'supported': 0, 'total_verifiable': 0, 'rate': None}
+Only exact extractive claims receive automatic support credit. Resolvable citations alone do not prove semantic support. Interpretations are flagged for human review; this conservative measure is not a semantic entailment score. Smoke audits are retained but not promoted to research metrics.
+
+## Scope precision/recall/F1
+
+Git baseline: {'tp': 0, 'fp': 0, 'fn': 0, 'precision': None, 'recall': None, 'f1': None, 'gold_unclear_excluded': 0, 'predicted_unclear': 0, 'decision_accuracy': None, 'cases': 0}

+Out-of-scope is the positive class. Gold unclear hunks are excluded from binary metrics and counted separately. Predicted unclear on a positive is a false negative. Zero denominators yield null, not invented scores.
+
+## Recovery nDCG
+
+Git baseline: {'ndcg': None, 'repositories': 0, 'predicted_ranking': [], 'ground_truth_ranking': []}
+Git log/blame script: {'ndcg': None, 'repositories': 0, 'predicted_ranking': [], 'ground_truth_ranking': []}
+Single-prompt LLM: {'ndcg': None, 'repositories': 0, 'predicted_ranking': [], 'ground_truth_ranking': []}
+Proposed AICAR: {'ndcg': None, 'repositories': 0, 'predicted_ranking': [], 'ground_truth_ranking': []}
+Full-cohort nDCG uses gain 2^grade-1 and log2(position+1) discounts, grades 0..3; deterministic case-ID tie break. At least two distinct human-labelled repositories are required. Any missing score makes the cohort metric unavailable.
+
+## Analysis time
+
+Measured pipeline seconds: 27.512967; shared validation/extraction: 27.262724. Executed: 21; successful: 21; errors: 0; skipped: 7. See timings.csv for timestamps and actual input counts. validation/extraction plus method execution; shared extraction is measured separately, report/plot generation excluded. No scaling trend or speedup is inferred from a single smoke run.

+Proposed AICAR | N/A — insufficient ground truth | N/A — insufficient ground truth | N/A — insufficient ground truth | N/A — insufficient ground truth
+
+## Limitations
+
+N/A in an unlabelled run means insufficient ground truth. In scored runs, consult task_status for missing methods or failures; recovery abstention and zero-denominator metrics also remain unavailable. No live model result exists in offline mode. One self-repository is not a representative benchmark; candidate regions need human selection. Entry points, dependencies, deployment and feature completeness are not executed/verified. Large/binary blobs are excluded from text feature counts and listed in evidence. Merge diffs use the first parent. No dashboard or provider integration success is implied. Legacy results and paper claims are excluded; paper files are unchanged.
+
+## Reproducibility instructions
+
+From repository root: `python -m pytest -q` then `python evaluation/runners/run_all.py --smoke`. After human annotation: `python evaluation/runners/run_all.py` for offline methods; add `--live` with GEMINI_API_KEY and GEMINI_MODEL set for live comparison. Run `python evaluation/figures.py` to regenerate figures. Immutable raw manifests contain code/dataset hashes, environment versions and complete input packs. Timing and live provider responses may vary.

+# 🏺 Agentic Code Archaeology
+
+**Agentic Code Archaeology** is an AI-powered, multi-agent system designed to reconstruct the intent behind legacy code, detect scope creep in commits, and evaluate the technical viability of recovering abandoned software projects.
+
+Built with **LangGraph, FastAPI, and React**, this project moves beyond traditional Git tools by synthesizing commit history, structural code patches, and file dependency graphs to explain *why* code exists, not just *what* changed.
+
+---
+
+## 🌟 Key Features
+
+1. **🧠 Intent Reconstruction (Intent Agent)**
+   * Deduces the developer's original intent behind code changes using an Intent-Oriented Chain-of-Thought strategy.
+   * Provides explicit evidence citations (referencing exact lines of code and commit SHAs) to prove its conclusions.
+
+2. **⚠️ Scope Creep Detection (Scope Agent)**
+   * Compares the stated goal of a commit against the actual structural code changes.
+   * Flags unrelated file modifications and architectural deviations that fall outside the bounds of the original task.
+
+3. **♻️ Abandoned Project Recovery (Recovery Agent)**
+   * Analyzes incomplete or abandoned repositories to calculate a heuristic **Health Score**.
+   * Replaces naive inactivity metrics (like commit frequency or stars) with deep structural indicators like code completeness, unresolved TODOs, and architectural continuity.
+   * **Multi-Project Comparison:** Ranks multiple repositories to recommend which project holds the highest technical viability for completion.
+
+4. **🕸️ Visual Relationship Graph**
+   * Renders a physics-based, 2D force-directed graph connecting commits to their modified files, allowing developers to visually spot high-risk architectural bottlenecks.
+
+5. **📊 Empirical Evaluation Suite (Research Ready)**
+   * Includes a built-in evaluation framework for academic research.
+   * Compares the Agentic System's accuracy against standard Git Baselines and zero-shot LLM Baselines.
+
+---
+
+## 🏗️ System Architecture
+
+* **Backend:** FastAPI, Python, SQLite
+* **AI Orchestration:** LangGraph (State-machine driven multi-agent workflow), OpenAI API
+* **Frontend:** React, Vite, CSS Grid, `react-force-graph-2d`
+
+---
+
+## 🚀 Getting Started
+
+### Prerequisites
+* Python 3.10+
+* Node.js 18+
+* An OpenAI API Key
+
+### 1. Backend Setup
+```bash
+cd backend
+python -m venv venv
+
+# Activate the virtual environment
+# Windows:
+venv\Scripts\activate
+# Mac/Linux:
+source venv/bin/activate
+
+pip install -r requirements.txt
+
+# Create a .env file and add your OpenAI API Key
+echo "OPENAI_API_KEY=your_actual_key_here" > .env
+
+# Start the FastAPI server
+uvicorn main:app --reload
+```
+*The backend will run on `http://127.0.0.1:8000`*
+
+### 2. Frontend Setup
+```bash
+cd frontend
+npm install
+npm run dev
+```
+*The React dashboard will run on `http://localhost:5173`*
+
+---
+
+## 🧪 Running the Evaluation Suite (For Research)
+
+To reproduce the accuracy metrics and generate matplotlib charts for the baseline comparisons:

+
+---
+
+## 📚 Academic Context & Related Work
+
+This project builds upon active research in the field of LLM-driven software engineering, explicitly differentiating itself from and expanding upon architectures like:
+* **Atomizer** (Zhu et al., 2026) and **ColaUntangle** (Hou et al., 2024) for intent-driven commit untangling.
+* **VIC-RAGENT** (Chen et al., 2026) for multi-stage reasoning with specialized code analyst agents.
+* Empirical investigations into open-source project survival (**Avelino et al., 2019**).
+
+By combining intent extraction, scope detection, and viability scoring into a single agentic ecosystem, this project provides a holistic solution to repository comprehension.

+import os
+import json
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+client = OpenAI(
+    api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+)
+
+
+def analyze_intent(commit, file_histories, evidence_map):
+
+    prompt = f"""
+You are an Evidence-Based Software Code Archaeology AI Agent.
+
+Your goal is to reconstruct WHY a code change exists.
+
+COMMIT HASH:
+{commit["hash"]}
+
+COMMIT MESSAGE:
+{commit["message"]}
+
+CHANGED FILES:
+{commit["changed_files"]}
+
+ACTUAL CODE DIFF:
+{commit.get("diff", [])}
+
+FILE HISTORY:
+{file_histories}
+
+EVIDENCE MAP:
+{evidence_map}
+
+Return ONLY valid JSON in this format:
+
+{{
+    "likely_intent": "...",
+    "code_change_summary": "...",
+    "historical_context": "...",
+    "confidence": "HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW",
+    "evidence": [
+        {{
+            "type": "commit | file | diff | history",
+            "reference": "...",
+            "reason": "Why this evidence supports the conclusion"
+        }}
+    ]
+}}
+
+Rules:
+- Every important conclusion must be supported by evidence.
+- Do not invent developer intentions.
+- Distinguish facts from inference.
+- If evidence is weak, use LOW confidence.
+"""
+
+    response = client.chat.completions.create(
+        model="gpt-4.1-mini",
+        messages=[
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": prompt
+            }
+        ],
+        response_format={"type": "json_object"}
+    )
+
+    return json.loads(
+        response.choices[0].message.content
+    )

+def calculate_accuracy(results, method):
+    correct = 0
+    total = len(results)
+
+    for item in results:
+        expected = item.get("expected_intent", "").lower().strip()
+
+        prediction = item.get(method, {}).get("prediction", "")
+
+        # If prediction is JSON/dict
+        if isinstance(prediction, dict):
+            prediction = prediction.get("likely_intent", "")
+        elif isinstance(prediction, str) and prediction.startswith("{"):
+            import json
+            try:
+                prediction = json.loads(prediction).get("likely_intent", "")
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+
+        prediction = str(prediction).lower()
+
+        # Simple keyword matching for MVP
+        if expected and expected in prediction:
+            correct += 1
+
+    if total == 0:
+        return 0
+
+    return (correct / total) * 100
+
+def calculate_evidence_score(results):
+    supported = 0
+    total = len(results)
+
+    for item in results:
+        prediction = item.get("agentic_system", {}).get("prediction", {})
+
+        if isinstance(prediction, str) and prediction.startswith("{"):
+            import json
+            try:
+                prediction = json.loads(prediction)
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+
+        if isinstance(prediction, dict):
+            evidence = prediction.get("evidence", [])
+            if len(evidence) > 0:
+                supported += 1
+
+    if total == 0:
+        return 0
+
+    return (supported / total) * 100
+
+def calculate_scope_metrics(tp, fp, fn):
+    precision = (
+        tp / (tp + fp)
+        if (tp + fp) > 0
+        else 0
+    )
+
+    recall = (
+        tp / (tp + fn)
+        if (tp + fn) > 0
+        else 0
+    )
+
+    f1 = (
+        2 * precision * recall /
+        (precision + recall)
+        if (precision + recall) > 0
+        else 0
+    )
+
+    return {
+        "precision": precision,
+        "recall": recall,
+        "f1_score": f1
+    }

@@ -0,0 +1,172 @@
+from typing import TypedDict, Optional
+from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, END
+
+from agents.intent_agent import analyze_intent
+from agents.scope_agent import analyze_scope
+from agents.recovery_agent import analyze_recovery
+from agents.report_agent import generate_final_report
+
+
+class AgentState(TypedDict):
+    repository_summary: dict
+    commit_history: list
+    file_histories: list
+    evidence_map: list
+    task_description: Optional[str]
+    changed_files: Optional[list]
+
+    intent_analysis: Optional[dict]
+    scope_analysis: Optional[str]
+    recovery_analysis: Optional[str]
+    final_report: Optional[str]
+
+def intent_node(state: AgentState):
+
+    if not state["commit_history"]:
+        return {
+            "intent_analysis": {
+                "likely_intent": "Unknown",
+                "confidence": "LOW",
+                "evidence": []
+            }
+        }
+
+    result = analyze_intent(
+        state["commit_history"][0],
+        state["file_histories"],
+        state["evidence_map"]
+    )
+
+    return {
+        "intent_analysis": result
+    }
+
+def scope_node(state: AgentState):
+
+    task = state.get("task_description")
+    changed_files = state.get("changed_files")
+
+    if not task or not changed_files:
+        return {
+            "scope_analysis":
+            "Scope analysis skipped because no task or changed files were provided."
+        }
+
+    result = analyze_scope(
+        task,
+        changed_files
+    )
+
+    return {
+        "scope_analysis": result
+    }
+
+def recovery_node(state: AgentState):
+
+    repository_data = {
+        "repository_summary":
+        state["repository_summary"],
+
+        "recent_commits":
+        state["commit_history"]
+    }
+
+    result = analyze_recovery(
+        repository_data
+    )
+
+    return {
+        "recovery_analysis": result
+    }
+
+def report_node(state: AgentState):
+
+    result = generate_final_report(
+        state["repository_summary"],
+        state["intent_analysis"],
+        state["scope_analysis"],
+        state["recovery_analysis"]
+    )
+
+    return {
+        "final_report": result
+    }
+
+def route_after_intent(state: AgentState):
+
+    commit_count = len(
+        state.get("commit_history", [])
+    )
+
+    # Not enough history
+    if commit_count < 2:
+        return "recovery_agent"
+
+    # Check if scope analysis is possible
+    if (
+        state.get("task_description")
+        and state.get("changed_files")
+    ):
+        return "scope_agent"
+
+    return "recovery_agent"
+
+def create_workflow():
+
+    workflow = StateGraph(AgentState)
+
+    # Add agent nodes
+    workflow.add_node(
+        "intent_agent",
+        intent_node
+    )
+
+    workflow.add_node(
+        "scope_agent",
+        scope_node
+    )
+
+    workflow.add_node(
+        "recovery_agent",
+        recovery_node
+    )
+
+    workflow.add_node(
+        "report_agent",
+        report_node
+    )
+
+    # Start workflow
+    workflow.set_entry_point(
+        "intent_agent"
+    )
+
+    # Agent flow
+    workflow.add_conditional_edges(
+        "intent_agent",
+        route_after_intent,
+        {
+            "scope_agent": "scope_agent",
+            "recovery_agent": "recovery_agent"
+        }
+    )
+
+    workflow.add_edge(
+        "scope_agent",
+        "recovery_agent"
+    )
+
+    workflow.add_edge(
+        "recovery_agent",
+        "report_agent"

+def calculate_health_score(
+    repository_summary,
+    intent_analysis,
+    recovery_analysis
+):
+    score = 100
+
+    # Repository information
+    total_commits = repository_summary.get("total_commits", 0)
+    todo_count = repository_summary.get("todo_count", 0)
+
+    # Less Git history
+    if total_commits < 5:
+        score -= 15
+
+    # More unfinished TODOs
+    if todo_count > 10:
+        score -= 15
+
+    # Recovery analysis
+    recovery_text = str(recovery_analysis).lower()
+
+    if "abandoned" in recovery_text:
+        score -= 10
+
+    if "incomplete" in recovery_text:
+        score -= 10
+
+    # Keep score between 0 and 100
+    score = max(0, min(score, 100))
+    return score
+
+def calculate_health_metrics(
+    repository_summary,
+    recovery_analysis
+):
+    total_commits = repository_summary.get("total_commits", 0)
+    todo_count = repository_summary.get("todo_count", 0)
+
+    # Git Activity
+    git_activity = min(total_commits * 5, 100)
+
+    # Code Completeness
+    completeness = max(0, 100 - (todo_count * 5))
+
+    # Recovery Potential
+    recovery_text = str(recovery_analysis).lower()
+    recovery_potential = 50
+
+    if "continue" in recovery_text:
+        recovery_potential += 30
+
+    if "high potential" in recovery_text:
+        recovery_potential += 20
+
+    return {
+        "git_activity": min(git_activity, 100),
+        "code_completeness": min(completeness, 100),
+        "recovery_potential": min(recovery_potential, 100)
+    }

+def calculate_recovery_score(project):
+    score = 0
+
+    # Higher completion is better
+    completion = project.get("completion_level", 0)
+    score += completion * 0.5
+
+    # Fewer TODOs is better
+    todo_count = project.get("todo_count", 0)
+    todo_score = max(0, 20 - todo_count)
+    score += todo_score
+
+    # Recent activity
+    activity_score = project.get("activity_score", 0)
+    score += activity_score * 0.3
+
+    return round(min(score, 100), 2)
+
+
+def rank_projects(projects):
+    ranked_projects = []
+
+    for project in projects:
+        recovery_score = calculate_recovery_score(project)
+
+        ranked_projects.append({
+            **project,
+            "recovery_score": recovery_score
+        })
+
+    return sorted(
+        ranked_projects,
+        key=lambda project: project["recovery_score"],
+        reverse=True
+    )

+import os
+import shutil
+import re
+from git import Repo
+
+def create_evidence_map(commit, file_histories):
+    evidence = []
+
+    # Commit evidence
+    evidence.append({
+        "id": "C1",
+        "type": "commit",
+        "reference": commit["hash"],
+        "content": commit["message"]
+    })
+
+    # File evidence
+    for index, file_name in enumerate(
+        commit.get("changed_files", [])
+    ):
+        evidence.append({
+            "id": f"F{index + 1}",
+            "type": "file",
+            "reference": file_name
+        })
+
+    # Diff evidence
+    for index, diff in enumerate(
+        commit.get("diff", [])
+    ):
+        evidence.append({
+            "id": f"D{index + 1}",
+            "type": "diff",
+            "reference": diff.get("file"),
+            "content": diff.get("diff", "")[:1000]
+        })
+
+    # History evidence
+    for index, history in enumerate(file_histories):
+        introducing = history.get(
+            "introducing_commit",
+            {}
+        )
+        evidence.append({
+            "id": f"H{index + 1}",
+            "type": "history",
+            "reference": history.get("file"),
+            "content": introducing.get("message")
+        })
+
+    return evidence
+
+def analyze_repository_data(github_url: str):
+    repo_path = "temp_repo"
+
+    def remove_readonly(func, path, excinfo):
+        import stat
+        os.chmod(path, stat.S_IWRITE)
+        func(path)
+
+    if os.path.exists(repo_path):
+        shutil.rmtree(repo_path, onerror=remove_readonly)
+
+    try:
+        # Clone repository
+        Repo.clone_from(github_url, repo_path)
+        repo = Repo(repo_path)
+
+        def get_file_history(repo, file_path):
+            try:
+                commits = list(repo.iter_commits(paths=file_path))
+                if not commits:
+                    return None
+                latest_commit = commits[0]
+                original_commit = commits[-1]
+                return {
+                    "file": file_path,
+                    "latest_change": {
+                        "hash": latest_commit.hexsha[:7],
+                        "message": latest_commit.message.strip(),
+                        "date": str(latest_commit.committed_datetime)
+                    },
+                    "introducing_commit": {
+                        "hash": original_commit.hexsha[:7],
+                        "message": original_commit.message.strip(),
+                        "date": str(original_commit.committed_datetime)
+                    },
+                    "total_changes": len(commits)
+                }
+            except Exception:
+                return None
+
+        def get_commit_diff(commit):
+            try:
+                diff_data = []
+                if commit.parents:
+                    parent = commit.parents[0]
+                    diffs = parent.diff(commit, create_patch=True)
+                    for diff in diffs:
+                        file_name = diff.b_path or diff.a_path
+                        patch = ""
+                        if diff.diff:
+                            patch = diff.diff.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
+                        # Limit each file diff
+                        patch = patch[:3000]
+                        diff_data.append({
+                            "file": file_name,
+                            "diff": patch
+                        })
+                        # Analyze maximum 5 files
+                        if len(diff_data) >= 5:
+                            break
+                return diff_data
+            except Exception:
+                return []
+
+        commits = list(repo.iter_commits())
+        commit_count = len(commits)
+        commit_history = []
+
+        for commit in commits[:10]:
+            changed_files = []
+            if commit.parents:
+                parent = commit.parents[0]
+                diffs = parent.diff(commit)
+                for diff in diffs:
+                    file_name = diff.b_path or diff.a_path
+                    if file_name:
+                        changed_files.append(file_name)
+            else:
+                changed_files = list(commit.stats.files.keys())
+
+            commit_diff = get_commit_diff(commit)
+
+            commit_history.append({
+                "hash": commit.hexsha[:7],
+                "message": commit.message.strip(),
+                "author": str(commit.author),
+                "date": str(commit.committed_datetime),
+                "changed_files": changed_files,
+                "diff": commit_diff
+            })
+
+        file_histories = []
+        if commit_history:
+            latest_changed_files = commit_history[0]["changed_files"]
+            for file_path in latest_changed_files[:5]:
+                history = get_file_history(repo, file_path)
+                if history:
+                    file_histories.append(history)
+
+        file_count = 0
+        todos = []
+
+        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(repo_path):
+            if ".git" in root:
+                continue
+            for file in files:
+                file_count += 1
+                file_path = os.path.join(root, file)
+                try:
+                    with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
+                        for line_number, line in enumerate(f, start=1):
+                            if re.search(r"\b(TODO|FIXME)\b", line, re.IGNORECASE):
+                                todos.append({
+                                    "file": file_path.replace(repo_path + os.sep, ""),
+                                    "line": line_number,
+                                    "content": line.strip()
+                                })
+                except Exception:
+                    continue
+
+        return {
+            "commit_count": commit_count,
+            "commit_history": commit_history,
+            "file_histories": file_histories,
+            "file_count": file_count,
+            "todos": todos
+        }
+
+    finally:
+        if os.path.exists(repo_path):
+            try:
+                shutil.rmtree(repo_path, onerror=remove_readonly)
+            except Exception:
+                pass

+def build_repository_graph(commit_history):
+    nodes = []
+    edges = []
+
+    file_nodes = set()
+
+    for commit in commit_history:
+
+        commit_id = f"commit-{commit['hash']}"
+
+        nodes.append({
+            "id": commit_id,
+            "label": commit["hash"],
+            "type": "commit"
+        })
+
+        for file_name in commit.get("changed_files", []):
+            file_id = f"file-{file_name}"
+
+            if file_id not in file_nodes:
+                nodes.append({
+                    "id": file_id,
+                    "label": file_name,
+                    "type": "file"
+                })
+                file_nodes.add(file_id)
+
+            edges.append({
+                "source": commit_id,
+                "target": file_id
+            })
+
+    return {
+        "nodes": nodes,
+        "edges": edges
+    }

+- Check whether the Scope Agent detects them
+

+- Add at least 2 repositories
+- Compare health metrics
+- Verify ranking and recommendation

+# React + TypeScript + Vite
+
+This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some Oxlint rules.
+
+Currently, two official plugins are available:
+
+- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
+- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)
+
+## React Compiler
+
+The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).
+
+## Expanding the Oxlint configuration
+
+If you are developing a production application, we recommend enabling type-aware lint rules by installing `oxlint-tsgolint` and editing `.oxlintrc.json`:
+
+```json
+{
+  "$schema": "./node_modules/oxlint/configuration_schema.json",
+  "plugins": ["react", "typescript", "oxc"],
+  "options": {
+    "typeAware": true
+  },
+  "rules": {
+    "react/rules-of-hooks": "error",
+    "react/only-export-components": ["warn", { "allowConstantExport": true }]
+  }
+}
+```
+
+See the [Oxlint rules documentation](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter/rules) for the full list of rules and categories.

diff --git a/frontend/src/App.css b/frontend/src/App.css
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..098d69a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/frontend/src/App.css
@@ -0,0 +1,156 @@
+* {
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+}
+
+body {
+  margin: 0;
+  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
+}
+
+.app {
+  min-height: 100vh;
+  padding: 40px;
+}
+
+header {
+  text-align: center;
+  margin-bottom: 40px;
+}
+
+header h1 {
+  font-size: 36px;
+  margin-bottom: 10px;
+}
+
+header p {
+  font-size: 18px;
+}
+
+main {
+  max-width: 1100px;
+  margin: auto;
+}
+
+.search-box {
+  display: flex;
+  gap: 10px;
+  margin-bottom: 40px;
+}
+
+.search-box input {
+  flex: 1;
+  padding: 15px;
+  font-size: 16px;
+}
+
+.search-box button {
+  padding: 15px 25px;
+  cursor: pointer;
+}
+
+.summary-grid {
+  display: grid;
+  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
+  gap: 20px;
+  margin-top: 20px;
+}
+
+.stat-card {
+  border: 1px solid #ddd;
+  border-radius: 12px;
+  padding: 25px;
+  text-align: center;
+}
+
+.stat-card span {
+  display: block;
+  margin-bottom: 10px;
+}
+
+.stat-card strong {
+  font-size: 32px;
+}
+
+.agents {
+  margin-top: 50px;
+}
+
+.agent-grid {
+  display: grid;
+  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
+  gap: 20px;
+  margin-top: 20px;
+}
+
+.agent-card {
+  border: 1px solid #ddd;
+  border-radius: 12px;
+  padding: 25px;
+  min-height: 300px;
+}
+
+.agent-card h3 {
+  margin-top: 0;
+}
+
+.analysis-content {
+  white-space: pre-wrap;
+  line-height: 1.6;
+}
+
+@media (max-width: 768px) {
+  .summary-grid,
+  .agent-grid {
+    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
+  }
+
+  .search-box {
+    flex-direction: column;
+  }
+}
+
+.final-report {
+  margin-top: 40px;
+}
+
+.final-report-card {
+  border: 1px solid #ddd;
+  border-radius: 12px;
+  padding: 30px;
+  white-space: pre-wrap;
+  line-height: 1.7;
+  font-size: 16px;
+}
+
+nav {
+  padding: 20px;
+  display: flex;
+  gap: 25px;
+  border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;
+}
+
+nav a {
+  text-decoration: none;
+  font-weight: bold;
+}
+
+.history-container {
+  max-width: 1000px;
+  margin: 40px auto;
+  padding: 20px;
+}
+
+.history-card {
+  border: 1px solid #ddd;
+  border-radius: 12px;
+  padding: 20px;
+  margin-top: 20px;
+}
+
+.history-report {
+  margin-top: 15px;
+  padding: 15px;
+  background: #f5f5f5;
+  white-space: pre-wrap;
+  line-height: 1.6;
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Link } from "react-router-dom";
+import Dashboard from "./pages/Dashboard";
+import History from "./pages/History";
+import Compare from "./pages/Compare";
+import "./App.css";
+
+function App() {
+  return (
+    <BrowserRouter>
+      <nav style={{ padding: "10px", background: "#333", display: "flex", gap: "20px" }}>
+        <Link to="/" style={{ color: "white", textDecoration: "none" }}>Dashboard</Link>
+        <Link to="/history" style={{ color: "white", textDecoration: "none" }}>History</Link>
+        <Link to="/compare" style={{ color: "white", textDecoration: "none" }}>Compare</Link>
+      </nav>
+
+      <Routes>
+        <Route path="/" element={<Dashboard />} />
+        <Route path="/history" element={<History />} />
+        <Route path="/compare" element={<Compare />} />
+      </Routes>
+    </BrowserRouter>
+  );
+}
+
+export default App;

+function IntentCard({ analysis }: any) {

+
+  return (
+    <section className="card">
+      <h2>🧠 Code Intent Analysis</h2>
+      <h3>Likely Intent</h3>
+      <p>{analysis.likely_intent || (typeof analysis === 'string' ? analysis : "No intent found")}</p>
+      
+      {analysis.confidence && (
+        <>
+          <h3>Confidence</h3>
+          <p>{analysis.confidence}</p>
+        </>
+      )}
+
+      {analysis.evidence && analysis.evidence.length > 0 && (
+        <>
+          <h3>Evidence</h3>
+          {analysis.evidence.map((item: any, index: number) => (
+            <div key={index} style={{ marginBottom: "10px", background: "#333", padding: "10px", borderRadius: "4px" }}>
+              <strong>{item.reference || item.id}</strong>
+              <p style={{ margin: "5px 0 0 0" }}>{item.reason || item.description}</p>
+            </div>
+          ))}
+        </>
+      )}
+    </section>
+  );
+}
+
+export default IntentCard;

+import { useState } from "react";
+import axios from "axios";
+
+function Compare() {
+  const [repositories, setRepositories] = useState([
+    "",
+    ""
+  ]);
+
+  const [results, setResults] = useState<any[]>([]);
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
+
+  const updateRepository = (
+    index: number,
+    value: string
+  ) => {
+    const updated = [...repositories];
+    updated[index] = value;
+    setRepositories(updated);
+  };
+
+  const addRepository = () => {
+    setRepositories([
+      ...repositories,
+      ""
+    ]);
+  };
+
+  const compareRepositories = async () => {
+    const validRepositories =
+      repositories.filter(
+        (repo) => repo.trim() !== ""
+      );
+
+    if (validRepositories.length < 2) {
+      alert(
+        "Please enter at least two repositories."
+      );
+      return;
+    }
+
+    try {
+      setLoading(true);
+
+      const response = await axios.post(
+        "http://127.0.0.1:8000/compare-repositories",
+        {
+          repositories: validRepositories
+        }
+      );
+
+      setResults(
+        response.data.repositories
+      );
+
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error(
+        "Comparison failed:",
+        error
+      );
+    } finally {
+      setLoading(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <div className="compare-container" style={{ padding: "40px", maxWidth: "900px", margin: "0 auto", textAlign: "left" }}>
+      <h1>Repository Comparison</h1>
+      <p style={{ color: "#aaa", marginBottom: "30px" }}>
+        Compare multiple repositories and identify the strongest project.
+      </p>

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

+
+function History() {
+  const [analyses, setAnalyses] = useState<any[]>([]);
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const fetchHistory = async () => {
+      try {
+        const response = await axios.get(
+          "http://127.0.0.1:8000/analysis-history"
+        );
+
+        setAnalyses(response.data);
+      } catch (error) {
+        console.error("Error loading history:", error);
+      } finally {
+        setLoading(false);
+      }
+    };
+
+    fetchHistory();
+  }, []);
+
+  if (loading) {
+    return <h2>Loading history...</h2>;
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <div className="history-container">
+      <h1>Analysis History</h1>
+
+      {analyses.length === 0 ? (
+        <p>No repository analyses yet.</p>
+      ) : (
+        analyses.map((analysis) => (
+          <div className="history-card" key={analysis.id}>
+            <h3>Repository Analysis #{analysis.id}</h3>
+
+            <p>
+              <strong>Repository:</strong>
+              <br />
+              {analysis.github_url}
+            </p>
+
+            <p>
+              <strong>Analyzed:</strong>
+              <br />
+              {new Date(analysis.created_at).toLocaleString()}
+            </p>
+
+            <details>
+              <summary>View Final Report</summary>
+
+              <div className="history-report">
+                {analysis.final_report}
+              </div>
+            </details>
+          </div>
+        ))
+      )}
+    </div>
+  );
+}

+export default History;

+# 🏺 Agentic Code Archaeology
+
+**Agentic Code Archaeology** is an AI-powered, multi-agent system designed to reconstruct the intent behind legacy code, detect scope creep in commits, and evaluate the technical viability of recovering abandoned software projects.
+
+Built with **LangGraph, FastAPI, and React**, this project moves beyond traditional Git tools by synthesizing commit history, structural code patches, and file dependency graphs to explain *why* code exists, not just *what* changed.
+
+---
+
+## 🌟 Key Features
+
+1. **🧠 Intent Reconstruction (Intent Agent)**
+   * Deduces the developer's original intent behind code changes using an Intent-Oriented Chain-of-Thought strategy.
+   * Provides explicit evidence citations (referencing exact lines of code and commit SHAs) to prove its conclusions.
+
+2. **⚠️ Scope Creep Detection (Scope Agent)**
+   * Compares the stated goal of a commit against the actual structural code changes.
+   * Flags unrelated file modifications and architectural deviations that fall outside the bounds of the original task.
+
+3. **♻️ Abandoned Project Recovery (Recovery Agent)**
+   * Analyzes incomplete or abandoned repositories to calculate a heuristic **Health Score**.
+   * Replaces naive inactivity metrics (like commit frequency or stars) with deep structural indicators like code completeness, unresolved TODOs, and architectural continuity.
+   * **Multi-Project Comparison:** Ranks multiple repositories to recommend which project holds the highest technical viability for completion.
+
+4. **🕸️ Visual Relationship Graph**
+   * Renders a physics-based, 2D force-directed graph connecting commits to their modified files, allowing developers to visually spot high-risk architectural bottlenecks.
+
+5. **📊 Empirical Evaluation Suite (Research Ready)**
+   * Includes a built-in evaluation framework for academic research.
+   * Compares the Agentic System's accuracy against standard Git Baselines and zero-shot LLM Baselines.
+
+---
+
+## 🏗️ System Architecture
+
+* **Backend:** FastAPI, Python, SQLite
+* **AI Orchestration:** LangGraph (State-machine driven multi-agent workflow), OpenAI API
+* **Frontend:** React, Vite, CSS Grid, `react-force-graph-2d`
+
+---
+
+## 🚀 Getting Started
+
+### Prerequisites
+* Python 3.10+
+* Node.js 18+
+* An OpenAI API Key
+
+### 1. Backend Setup
+```bash
+cd backend
+python -m venv venv
+
+# Activate the virtual environment
+# Windows:
+venv\Scripts\activate
+# Mac/Linux:
+source venv/bin/activate
+
+pip install -r requirements.txt
+
+# Create a .env file and add your OpenAI API Key
+echo "OPENAI_API_KEY=your_actual_key_here" > .env
+
+# Start the FastAPI server
+uvicorn main:app --reload
+```
+*The backend will run on `http://127.0.0.1:8000`*
+
+### 2. Frontend Setup
+```bash
+cd frontend
+npm install
+npm run dev
+```
+*The React dashboard will run on `http://localhost:5173`*
+
+---
+
+## 🧪 Running the Evaluation Suite (For Research)
+
+To reproduce the accuracy metrics and generate matplotlib charts for the baseline comparisons:
+
+```bash
+cd evaluation/baselines
+python run_evaluation.py
+python ../metrics.py
+python ../generate_report.py
+```
+*Results and charts will be saved to `evaluation/results/`.*
+
+---
+
+## 📚 Academic Context & Related Work
+
+This project builds upon active research in the field of LLM-driven software engineering, explicitly differentiating itself from and expanding upon architectures like:
+* **Atomizer** (Zhu et al., 2026) and **ColaUntangle** (Hou et al., 2024) for intent-driven commit untangling.
+* **VIC-RAGENT** (Chen et al., 2026) for multi-stage reasoning with specialized code analyst agents.
+* Empirical investigations into open-source project survival (**Avelino et al., 2019**).
+
+By combining intent extraction, scope detection, and viability scoring into a single agentic ecosystem, this project provides a holistic solution to repository comprehension.

+
+def analyze_intent(commit, file_histories, evidence_map):
+
+    prompt = f"""
+You are an Evidence-Based Software Code Archaeology AI Agent.
+
+Your goal is to reconstruct WHY a code change exists.
+
+COMMIT HASH:

+def calculate_accuracy(results, method):
+    correct = 0
+    total = len(results)
+
+    for item in results:
+        expected = item.get("expected_intent", "").lower().strip()
+
+        prediction = item.get(method, {}).get("prediction", "")
+
+        # If prediction is JSON/dict
+        if isinstance(prediction, dict):
+            prediction = prediction.get("likely_intent", "")
+        elif isinstance(prediction, str) and prediction.startswith("{"):
+            import json
+            try:
+                prediction = json.loads(prediction).get("likely_intent", "")
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+
+        prediction = str(prediction).lower()
+
+        # Simple keyword matching for MVP
+        if expected and expected in prediction:
+            correct += 1
+
+    if total == 0:
+        return 0
+
+    return (correct / total) * 100
+
+def calculate_evidence_score(results):
+    supported = 0
+    total = len(results)
+
+    for item in results:
+        prediction = item.get("agentic_system", {}).get("prediction", {})
+
+        if isinstance(prediction, str) and prediction.startswith("{"):
+            import json
+            try:
+                prediction = json.loads(prediction)
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+
+        if isinstance(prediction, dict):
+            evidence = prediction.get("evidence", [])
+            if len(evidence) > 0:
+                supported += 1
+
+    if total == 0:
+        return 0
+
+    return (supported / total) * 100
+
+def calculate_scope_metrics(tp, fp, fn):
+    precision = (
+        tp / (tp + fp)
+        if (tp + fp) > 0
+        else 0
+    )
+
+    recall = (
+        tp / (tp + fn)
+        if (tp + fn) > 0
+        else 0
+    )
+
+    f1 = (
+        2 * precision * recall /
+        (precision + recall)
+        if (precision + recall) > 0
+        else 0
+    )
+
+    return {
+        "precision": precision,
+        "recall": recall,
+        "f1_score": f1
+    }

+from typing import TypedDict, Optional
+from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, END
+
+from agents.intent_agent import analyze_intent
+from agents.scope_agent import analyze_scope
+from agents.recovery_agent import analyze_recovery
+from agents.report_agent import generate_final_report
+
+
+class AgentState(TypedDict):
+    repository_summary: dict
+    commit_history: list
+    file_histories: list
+    evidence_map: list
+    task_description: Optional[str]
+    changed_files: Optional[list]
+
+    intent_analysis: Optional[dict]
+    scope_analysis: Optional[str]
+    recovery_analysis: Optional[str]
+    final_report: Optional[str]
+
+def intent_node(state: AgentState):
+
+    if not state["commit_history"]:
+        return {
+            "intent_analysis": {
+                "likely_intent": "Unknown",
+                "confidence": "LOW",
+                "evidence": []
+            }
+        }
+
+    result = analyze_intent(
+        state["commit_history"][0],
+        state["file_histories"],
+        state["evidence_map"]
+    )
+
+    return {
+        "intent_analysis": result
+    }
+
+def scope_node(state: AgentState):
+
+    task = state.get("task_description")
+    changed_files = state.get("changed_files")
+
+    if not task or not changed_files:
+        return {
+            "scope_analysis":
+            "Scope analysis skipped because no task or changed files were provided."
+        }
+
+    result = analyze_scope(
+        task,
+        changed_files
+    )
+
+    return {
+        "scope_analysis": result
+    }
+
+def recovery_node(state: AgentState):
+
+    repository_data = {
+        "repository_summary":
+        state["repository_summary"],
+
+        "recent_commits":
+        state["commit_history"]
+    }
+
+    result = analyze_recovery(
+        repository_data
+    )
+
+    return {
+        "recovery_analysis": result
+    }
+
+def report_node(state: AgentState):
+
+    result = generate_final_report(
+        state["repository_summary"],
+        state["intent_analysis"],
+        state["scope_analysis"],
+        state["recovery_analysis"]
+    )
+
+    return {
+        "final_report": result
+    }
+
+def route_after_intent(state: AgentState):
+
+    commit_count = len(
+        state.get("commit_history", [])
+    )
+
+    # Not enough history
+    if commit_count < 2:
+        return "recovery_agent"
+
+    # Check if scope analysis is possible
+    if (
+        state.get("task_description")
+        and state.get("changed_files")
+    ):
+        return "scope_agent"
+
+    return "recovery_agent"
+
+def create_workflow():
+
+    workflow = StateGraph(AgentState)
+
+    # Add agent nodes
+    workflow.add_node(
+        "intent_agent",
+        intent_node
+    )
+
+    workflow.add_node(
+        "scope_agent",
+        scope_node
+    )
+
+    workflow.add_node(
+        "recovery_agent",
+        recovery_node
+    )
+
+    workflow.add_node(
+        "report_agent",
+        report_node
+    )
+
+    # Start workflow
+    workflow.set_entry_point(
+        "intent_agent"
+    )
+
+    # Agent flow
+    workflow.add_conditional_edges(
+        "intent_agent",
+        route_after_intent,
+        {
+            "scope_agent": "scope_agent",
+            "recovery_agent": "recovery_agent"
+        }
+    )
+
+    workflow.add_edge(
+        "scope_agent",
+        "recovery_agent"
+    )
+
+    workflow.add_edge(
+        "recovery_agent",
+        "report_agent"
+    )
+
+    workflow.add_edge(
+        "report_agent",
+        END
+    )
+
+    return workflow.compile()
+
+
+agent_workflow = create_workflow()

+def calculate_health_score(
+    repository_summary,
+    intent_analysis,
+    recovery_analysis
+):
+    score = 100
+
+    # Repository information
+    total_commits = repository_summary.get("total_commits", 0)
+    todo_count = repository_summary.get("todo_count", 0)
+
+    # Less Git history
+    if total_commits < 5:
+        score -= 15
+
+    # More unfinished TODOs
+    if todo_count > 10:
+        score -= 15
+
+    # Recovery analysis
+    recovery_text = str(recovery_analysis).lower()
+
+    if "abandoned" in recovery_text:
+        score -= 10
+
+    if "incomplete" in recovery_text:
+        score -= 10
+
+    # Keep score between 0 and 100
+    score = max(0, min(score, 100))
+    return score
+
+def calculate_health_metrics(
+    repository_summary,
+    recovery_analysis
+):
+    total_commits = repository_summary.get("total_commits", 0)
+    todo_count = repository_summary.get("todo_count", 0)
+
+    # Git Activity
+    git_activity = min(total_commits * 5, 100)
+
+    # Code Completeness
+    completeness = max(0, 100 - (todo_count * 5))
+
+    # Recovery Potential
+    recovery_text = str(recovery_analysis).lower()
+    recovery_potential = 50
+
+    if "continue" in recovery_text:
+        recovery_potential += 30
+
+    if "high potential" in recovery_text:
+        recovery_potential += 20
+
+    return {
+        "git_activity": min(git_activity, 100),
+        "code_completeness": min(completeness, 100),
+        "recovery_potential": min(recovery_potential, 100)
+    }

+def calculate_recovery_score(project):
+    score = 0
+
+    # Higher completion is better
+    completion = project.get("completion_level", 0)
+    score += completion * 0.5
+
+    # Fewer TODOs is better
+    todo_count = project.get("todo_count", 0)
+    todo_score = max(0, 20 - todo_count)
+    score += todo_score
+
+    # Recent activity
+    activity_score = project.get("activity_score", 0)
+    score += activity_score * 0.3
+
+    return round(min(score, 100), 2)
+
+
+def rank_projects(projects):
+    ranked_projects = []
+
+    for project in projects:
+        recovery_score = calculate_recovery_score(project)
+
+        ranked_projects.append({
+            **project,
+            "recovery_score": recovery_score
+        })
+
+    return sorted(
+        ranked_projects,
+        key=lambda project: project["recovery_score"],
+        reverse=True
+    )

+import os
+import shutil
+import re
+from git import Repo
+
+def create_evidence_map(commit, file_histories):
+    evidence = []
+
+    # Commit evidence
+    evidence.append({
+        "id": "C1",
+        "type": "commit",
+        "reference": commit["hash"],
+        "content": commit["message"]
+    })
+
+    # File evidence
+    for index, file_name in enumerate(
+        commit.get("changed_files", [])
+    ):
+        evidence.append({
+            "id": f"F{index + 1}",
+            "type": "file",
+            "reference": file_name
+        })
+
+    # Diff evidence
+    for index, diff in enumerate(
+        commit.get("diff", [])
+    ):
+        evidence.append({
+            "id": f"D{index + 1}",
+            "type": "diff",
+            "reference": diff.get("file"),
+            "content": diff.get("diff", "")[:1000]
+        })
+
+    # History evidence
+    for index, history in enumerate(file_histories):
+        introducing = history.get(
+            "introducing_commit",
+            {}
+        )
+        evidence.append({
+            "id": f"H{index + 1}",
+            "type": "history",
+            "reference": history.get("file"),
+            "content": introducing.get("message")
+        })
+
+    return evidence
+
+def analyze_repository_data(github_url: str):
+    repo_path = "temp_repo"
+
+    def remove_readonly(func, path, excinfo):
+        import stat
+        os.chmod(path, stat.S_IWRITE)
+        func(path)
+
+    if os.path.exists(repo_path):
+        shutil.rmtree(repo_path, onerror=remove_readonly)
+
+    try:
+        # Clone repository
+        Repo.clone_from(github_url, repo_path)
+        repo = Repo(repo_path)
+
+        def get_file_history(repo, file_path):
+            try:
+                commits = list(repo.iter_commits(paths=file_path))
+                if not commits:
+                    return None
+                latest_commit = commits[0]
+                original_commit = commits[-1]
+                return {
+                    "file": file_path,
+                    "latest_change": {
+                        "hash": latest_commit.hexsha[:7],
+                        "message": latest_commit.message.strip(),
+                        "date": str(latest_commit.committed_datetime)
+                    },
+                    "introducing_commit": {
+                        "hash": original_commit.hexsha[:7],
+                        "message": original_commit.message.strip(),
+                        "date": str(original_commit.committed_datetime)
+                    },
+                    "total_changes": len(commits)
+                }
+            except Exception:
+                return None
+
+        def get_commit_diff(commit):
+            try:
+                diff_data = []
+                if commit.parents:
+                    parent = commit.parents[0]
+                    diffs = parent.diff(commit, create_patch=True)
+                    for diff in diffs:
+                        file_name = diff.b_path or diff.a_path
+                        patch = ""
+                        if diff.diff:
+                            patch = diff.diff.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
+                        # Limit each file diff
+                        patch = patch[:3000]
+                        diff_data.append({
+                            "file": file_name,
+                            "diff": patch
+                        })
+                        # Analyze maximum 5 files
+                        if len(diff_data) >= 5:
+                            break
+                return diff_data
+            except Exception:
+                return []
+
+        commits = list(repo.iter_commits())
+        commit_count = len(commits)
+        commit_history = []
+
+        for commit in commits[:10]:
+            changed_files = []
+            if commit.parents:
+                parent = commit.parents[0]
+                diffs = parent.diff(commit)
+                for diff in diffs:
+                    file_name = diff.b_path or diff.a_path
+                    if file_name:
+                        changed_files.append(file_name)
+            else:
+                changed_files = list(commit.stats.files.keys())
+
+            commit_diff = get_commit_diff(commit)
+
+            commit_history.append({
+                "hash": commit.hexsha[:7],
+                "message": commit.message.strip(),
+                "author": str(commit.author),
+                "date": str(commit.committed_datetime),
+                "changed_files": changed_files,
+                "diff": commit_diff
+            })
+
+        file_histories = []
+        if commit_history:
+            latest_changed_files = commit_history[0]["changed_files"]
+            for file_path in latest_changed_files[:5]:
+                history = get_file_history(repo, file_path)
+                if history:
+                    file_histories.append(history)
+
+        file_count = 0
+        todos = []
+
+        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(repo_path):
+            if ".git" in root:
+                continue
+            for file in files:
+                file_count += 1
+                file_path = os.path.join(root, file)
+                try:
+                    with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
+                        for line_number, line in enumerate(f, start=1):
+                            if re.search(r"\b(TODO|FIXME)\b", line, re.IGNORECASE):
+                                todos.append({
+                                    "file": file_path.replace(repo_path + os.sep, ""),
+                                    "line": line_number,
+                                    "content": line.strip()
+                                })
+                except Exception:
+                    continue
+
+        return {
+            "commit_count": commit_count,
+            "commit_history": commit_history,
+            "file_histories": file_histories,
+            "file_count": file_count,
+            "todos": todos
+        }
+
+    finally:
+        if os.path.exists(repo_path):
+            try:
+                shutil.rmtree(repo_path, onerror=remove_readonly)
+            except Exception:
+                pass

+def build_repository_graph(commit_history):
+    nodes = []
+    edges = []
+
+    file_nodes = set()
+
+    for commit in commit_history:
+
+        commit_id = f"commit-{commit['hash']}"
+
+        nodes.append({
+            "id": commit_id,
+            "label": commit["hash"],
+            "type": "commit"
+        })
+
+        for file_name in commit.get("changed_files", []):
+            file_id = f"file-{file_name}"
+
+            if file_id not in file_nodes:
+                nodes.append({
+                    "id": file_id,
+                    "label": file_name,
+                    "type": "file"
+                })
+                file_nodes.add(file_id)
+
+            edges.append({
+                "source": commit_id,
+                "target": file_id
+            })
+
+    return {
+        "nodes": nodes,
+        "edges": edges
+    }

+# React + TypeScript + Vite
+
+This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some Oxlint rules.
+
+Currently, two official plugins are available:
+
+- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
+- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)
+
+## React Compiler
+
+The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).
+
+## Expanding the Oxlint configuration
+
+If you are developing a production application, we recommend enabling type-aware lint rules by installing `oxlint-tsgolint` and editing `.oxlintrc.json`:
+
+```json
+{
+  "$schema": "./node_modules/oxlint/configuration_schema.json",
+  "plugins": ["react", "typescript", "oxc"],
+  "options": {
+    "typeAware": true
+  },
+  "rules": {
+    "react/rules-of-hooks": "error",
+    "react/only-export-components": ["warn", { "allowConstantExport": true }]
+  }
+}
+```
+
+See the [Oxlint rules documentation](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter/rules) for the full list of rules and categories.

diff --git a/frontend/src/App.css b/frontend/src/App.css
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..098d69a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/frontend/src/App.css
@@ -0,0 +1,156 @@
+* {
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+}
+
+body {
+  margin: 0;
+  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
+}
+
+.app {
+  min-height: 100vh;
+  padding: 40px;
+}
+
+header {
+  text-align: center;
+  margin-bottom: 40px;
+}
+
+header h1 {
+  font-size: 36px;
+  margin-bottom: 10px;
+}
+
+header p {
+  font-size: 18px;
+}
+
+main {
+  max-width: 1100px;
+  margin: auto;
+}
+
+.search-box {
+  display: flex;
+  gap: 10px;
+  margin-bottom: 40px;
+}
+
+.search-box input {
+  flex: 1;
+  padding: 15px;
+  font-size: 16px;
+}
+
+.search-box button {
+  padding: 15px 25px;
+  cursor: pointer;
+}
+
+.summary-grid {
+  display: grid;
+  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
+  gap: 20px;
+  margin-top: 20px;
+}
+
+.stat-card {
+  border: 1px solid #ddd;
+  border-radius: 12px;
+  padding: 25px;
+  text-align: center;
+}
+
+.stat-card span {
+  display: block;
+  margin-bottom: 10px;
+}
+
+.stat-card strong {
+  font-size: 32px;
+}
+
+.agents {
+  margin-top: 50px;
+}
+
+.agent-grid {
+  display: grid;
+  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
+  gap: 20px;
+  margin-top: 20px;
+}
+
+.agent-card {
+  border: 1px solid #ddd;
+  border-radius: 12px;
+  padding: 25px;
+  min-height: 300px;
+}
+
+.agent-card h3 {
+  margin-top: 0;
+}
+
+.analysis-content {
+  white-space: pre-wrap;
+  line-height: 1.6;
+}
+
+@media (max-width: 768px) {
+  .summary-grid,
+  .agent-grid {
+    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
+  }
+
+  .search-box {
+    flex-direction: column;
+  }
+}
+
+.final-report {
+  margin-top: 40px;
+}
+
+.final-report-card {
+  border: 1px solid #ddd;
+  border-radius: 12px;
+  padding: 30px;
+  white-space: pre-wrap;
+  line-height: 1.7;
+  font-size: 16px;
+}
+
+nav {
+  padding: 20px;
+  display: flex;
+  gap: 25px;
+  border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;
+}
+
+nav a {
+  text-decoration: none;
+  font-weight: bold;
+}
+
+.history-container {
+  max-width: 1000px;
+  margin: 40px auto;
+  padding: 20px;
+}
+
+.history-card {
+  border: 1px solid #ddd;
+  border-radius: 12px;
+  padding: 20px;
+  margin-top: 20px;
+}
+
+.history-report {
+  margin-top: 15px;
+  padding: 15px;
+  background: #f5f5f5;
+  white-space: pre-wrap;
+  line-height: 1.6;
+}

+import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Link } from "react-router-dom";
+import Dashboard from "./pages/Dashboard";
+import History from "./pages/History";
+import Compare from "./pages/Compare";
+import "./App.css";
+
+function App() {
+  return (
+    <BrowserRouter>
+      <nav style={{ padding: "10px", background: "#333", display: "flex", gap: "20px" }}>
+        <Link to="/" style={{ color: "white", textDecoration: "none" }}>Dashboard</Link>
+        <Link to="/history" style={{ color: "white", textDecoration: "none" }}>History</Link>
+        <Link to="/compare" style={{ color: "white", textDecoration: "none" }}>Compare</Link>
+      </nav>
+
+      <Routes>
+        <Route path="/" element={<Dashboard />} />
+        <Route path="/history" element={<History />} />
+        <Route path="/compare" element={<Compare />} />
+      </Routes>
+    </BrowserRouter>
+  );
+}
+
+export default App;

+function IntentCard({ analysis }: any) {
+  if (!analysis) return null;
+
+  return (
+    <section className="card">
+      <h2>🧠 Code Intent Analysis</h2>
+      <h3>Likely Intent</h3>
+      <p>{analysis.likely_intent || (typeof analysis === 'string' ? analysis : "No intent found")}</p>
+      
+      {analysis.confidence && (
+        <>
+          <h3>Confidence</h3>
+          <p>{analysis.confidence}</p>
+        </>
+      )}
+
+      {analysis.evidence && analysis.evidence.length > 0 && (
+        <>
+          <h3>Evidence</h3>
+          {analysis.evidence.map((item: any, index: number) => (
+            <div key={index} style={{ marginBottom: "10px", background: "#333", padding: "10px", borderRadius: "4px" }}>
+              <strong>{item.reference || item.id}</strong>
+              <p style={{ margin: "5px 0 0 0" }}>{item.reason || item.description}</p>
+            </div>
+          ))}
+        </>
+      )}
+    </section>
+  );
+}
+
+export default IntentCard;

+import ForceGraph2D from "react-force-graph-2d";
+
+interface GraphProps {
+  graphData: {
+    nodes: any[];
+    edges: any[];
+  };
+}
+
+function RepositoryGraph({ graphData }: GraphProps) {
+  const data = {
+    nodes: graphData.nodes,
+    links: graphData.edges
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <div style={{ height: "600px", width: "100%", background: "#111", borderRadius: "8px", overflow: "hidden", marginTop: "20px" }}>
+      <ForceGraph2D
+        graphData={data}
+        nodeLabel="label"
+        nodeAutoColorBy="type"
+      />
+    </div>
+  );
+}
+
+export default RepositoryGraph;
